result.description: Custom WAF rules to block bad bots and protect server resources
result.name: P2P Foundation Bot Protection

rules.description: Block aggressive SEO crawlers and vuln scanners at the edge
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "MJ12bot") or (http.user_agent contains "AhrefsBot") or (http.user_agent contains "SemrushBot") or (http.user_agent contains "DotBot") or (http.user_agent contains "BLEXBot") or (http.user_agent contains "MegaIndex") or (http.user_agent contains "Bytespider") or (http.user_agent contains "PetalBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Barkrowler") or (http.user_agent contains "trendictionbot") or (http.user_agent contains "IbouBot") or (http.user_agent contains "Nikto") or (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap") or (http.user_agent contains "ZmEu")

rules.description: Challenge bots hitting expensive API/feed endpoints (incl. URL-encoded wiki Special:RecentChanges)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-json/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/feed") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/xmlrpc.php") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/trackback") or (http.host eq "wiki.p2pfoundation.net" and (http.request.uri.query contains "Special%3ARecentChanges" or http.request.uri.query contains "feedrecentchanges")) or (http.host eq "wiki.p2pfoundation.net" and (http.request.uri.query contains "action=history" or http.request.uri.query contains "diff=" or http.request.uri.query contains "oldid=" or http.request.uri contains "Special:WhatLinksHere" or http.request.uri contains "Special%3AWhatLinksHere" or http.request.uri contains "Special:RecentChangesLinked" or http.request.uri contains "Special%3ARecentChangesLinked" or http.request.uri contains "Special:Contributions" or http.request.uri contains "Special%3AContributions" or http.request.uri contains "Special:Search" or http.request.uri contains "Special%3ASearch" or http.request.uri contains "Special:Log" or http.request.uri contains "Special%3ALog"))

(http.request.uri.path contains "/ALFA_DATA/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-content/plugins/pwnd") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-content/plugins/developer-flavor") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.env") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/wp-config.php.bak") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/debug.log") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/.git/")

rules.description: Challenge requests with empty or suspicious user agents
rules.expression: (http.user_agent eq "") or (not http.user_agent contains "Mozilla" and not http.user_agent contains "bot" and not http.user_agent contains "Bot" and not http.user_agent contains "spider" and not http.user_agent contains "Spider" and not http.user_agent contains "crawl" and not http.user_agent contains "Crawl" and not http.user_agent contains "curl" and not http.user_agent contains "Uptime" and not http.user_agent contains "FeedBurner" and not http.user_agent contains "feedparser" and not http.user_agent contains "GPTBot" and not http.user_agent contains "ClaudeBot" and not http.user_agent contains "CCBot" and not http.user_agent contains "Applebot")
